SetStealTaskbarFocus
public void SetStealTaskbarFocus(
bool 
steal
)

Taskbar has a high priority for the focus, so the pet will go to background on it. If this option is set, the pet will steal the focus from the taskbar and will be in the foreground.  Note: this will have strange effects on Windows.

Parameter
steal
bool

true, if the pet should steal the taskbar focus
